description: Pinned local preplanning, lifecycle and native-chat builds installed 2026-11-15. Recovery still requires unchanged inputs, policy, tools and an exclusive lease. Also pins both local 2026-11-16 compaction-display builds: only execution-output history classification differs; model inputs, tools and execution policy remain unchanged. Also pins the installed 2026-11-17 pre-edit-rejection build for unchanged-input recovery; native edit validation and Messages history comparison are repaired without changing model prompts or tool authority. Pins the exact installed pre-blacklist 2026-11-17 build for user-authorized manual recovery after the tool-error policy upgrade. Task prompts, permissions, graph and evidence remain pinned; the next execution adopts and records the current registered error policy. No automatic resume is authorized. Pins the exact installed 2026-11-17 pre-performance-index build for manual unchanged-input recovery; only statistics projection indexing and disposable cache layout change. Existing prompts, model requests, tool authority and task checkpoints are unchanged. Pins the exact installed 2026-11-17 performance-index build for manual continuation of existing leaf checkpoints after the command-entry update. Leaf request preparation, report contracts and task authority are unchanged; saved requests remain pinned. New planners acquire a discussion handoff; old planner prompts and tool surfaces are retained. Controller activation changes to human commands, and JSON summaries omit absent optional fields. The new history reader is preplanning-only. Model/configuration/input changes still reject continuation; no automatic resume is authorized. The exact installed command-entry build also permits manual continuation with the authorized runtime defaults workspace-write/ask changed to auto/auto. Only these two fields may differ; model, budget, prompt, goal and task configuration remain pinned. Permission changes are checked at each native dispatch and recorded, with tool revocation receipts. No automatic resume. Pins the local permissions-settings build for exact continuation after native read_image admission is aligned for new graph bindings. Existing leaf tool and request snapshots are preserved. Pins the previous installed image-admission build for manual recovery with unchanged input and tools after workspace tool registration and audit frame evidence were added. Manual unchanged-input recovery also recognizes the exact pre-role-tool-error-policy build of 2026-11-18. Stored request and tool identities remain subject to their existing checks. Pins the local 2026-11-18 role-tool-policy candidate for manual unchanged-input recovery after audit-tool feedback and documentation updates. Existing role requests and receipts retain their original tool descriptions. Pins the installed 2026-11-18 workspace-audit usage build for manual recovery of interrupted image-bearing requests. Model inputs, tools and approvals remain pinned; the recovery check now reconstructs images from sealed request bytes. Pins the installed 2026-11-18 image-rewind build for manual recovery after duplicate socket interruptions. Existing history and receipts stay exact; the resumed image request may run byte-bounded native compaction before the next send. Pins the 2026-11-18 transport recovery build for manual continuation after preventing faulted managed execution from falling through to the native controller. Saved work and tool contracts remain pinned. Pins the previous local build for explicit recovery with saved tool contracts after switching audit images to the native host reader. Includes the exact local rc.52 2026-11-18 version-lock build for the bounded image window. Stored tools, policy, configuration and historical requests remain verified. The pre-role-model build is eligible for the same explicit recovery. A checkpoint without a role model receipt retains its original backend. Includes the exact local rc.62 build preceding the 2026-11-24 storage and fingerprint optimizations for explicit recovery with identical inputs and policy.
